title: Zechariah Bible Quiz - Chapter 13
description: Ten questions on Zechariah 13: the spring opened for sin, the end of the idols and false prophets, and the refining of the third part.

questions.text: What will be opened to David's house and the inhabitants of Jerusalem in that day?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 13:1 says a spring will be opened to David's house and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, for sin and for uncleanness.

answers.text: A new gate in the city wall
A sealed book of the law
A spring for sin and uncleanness

questions.text: What does Yahweh of Armies say he will cut off out of the land?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 13:2 says he will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, so that they are remembered no more.

questions.text: According to verse 3, what will the father and mother of someone who still prophesies do?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 13:3 says his father and his mother who bore him will tell him he must die, and will stab him when he prophesies.

answers.text: Pay a priest to plead for him

questions.text: What will the prophets no longer wear in that day?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 13:4 says they will be ashamed of their visions and will not wear a hairy mantle to deceive.

questions.text: What will such a man say about himself instead of claiming to be a prophet?
questions.explanation: In Zechariah 13:5 he says: I am no prophet, I am a tiller of the ground, for I have been made a bondservant from my youth.

answers.text: That he is a tiller of the ground

questions.text: How does the man answer the question about the wounds between his arms?
questions.explanation: In Zechariah 13:6 he answers that those are the wounds with which he was wounded in the house of his friends.

answers.text: That he was wounded in the house of his friends
That he fell among robbers on the road
That the sword of the enemy struck him
That he does not know where they came from

questions.text: What does Yahweh of Armies say will happen when the shepherd is struck?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 13:7 says: Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered; and I will turn my hand against the little ones.

answers.text: The land will be at rest
A new shepherd will rise at once

questions.text: What does verse 8 say will happen in all the land?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 13:8 says two parts in it will be cut off and die, but the third will be left in it.

answers.text: The whole land will be spared from the sword
Half of the land will be burned with fire
Two parts will be cut off and die, and a third will be left
Every family will be carried away captive

questions.text: How will Yahweh treat the third part that is left?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 13:9 says he will bring them into the fire, refine them as silver is refined and test them like gold is tested.

answers.text: He will refine them as silver and test them like gold
He will settle them in the land of Egypt
He will hide them in the mountains
He will hand them over to the nations

questions.text: What will the refined people say when they call on Yahweh's name?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 13:9 says Yahweh will say: It is my people; and they will say: Yahweh is my God.
